Saved edits to **only rows 58 and 65** of `heads.head.weight` and `heads.head.bias`. The backbone and other 198 classifier rows remain unchanged.

### What changed
- Blended the original gull decision direction with a centroid-based direction derived from last-block residual statistics: **25% original, 75% new**.
- Translated that direction into the final-LayerNorm head coordinates.
- Added a shared correction based on the original gull-confidence scores to suppress unintended gull predictions on unrelated images.

All changes used activation statistics and linear algebra, without training.

### Verified practice results

| Metric | Original | Edited |
|---|---:|---:|
| California vs. Western Gull | 43.33% (13/30) | **66.67% (20/30)** |
| California Gull | 20.00% | **46.67%** |
| Western Gull | 66.67% | **86.67%** |
| Overall accuracy | 84.14% | **84.31%** |

The edit gained seven correct pair predictions and lost two correct non-pair predictions, for **five additional correct predictions overall**.

Leave-one-out diagnostics gave 19/30 correct pair predictions; repeated balanced-split checks also showed improvement. These support the choice, but held-out performance remains unmeasured.
